name: Valdepiélago (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad crimson horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Valdepiélago (trees and towers on green and yellow) between the inscriptions Valdepiélago and Real Encartación del Curueño in white.
history: Municipal flag of Valdepiélago; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
